name: opencode_lynx

repository.url: TODO: fill in GitHub URL before publishing

homepage: TODO: set when a landing page exists

bugs.url: TODO: set to the issues URL

scripts.gate:ios-deeplink-smoke: bash -lc 'set -eo pipefail; tmp=$(mktemp); xcodebuild test -workspace ios/OpenCodeLynx.xcworkspace -scheme OpenCodeLynxUITests -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 16" "-only-testing:OpenCodeLynxUITests/OpenCodeLynxUITests/testDeepLinkStartupHappyPathAndConsumeOnceFallbacksToDefaultOnSecondLaunch" "-only-testing:OpenCodeLynxUITests/OpenCodeLynxUITests/testDeepLinkStartupInvalidTargetFailsClosedToMainPath" -parallel-testing-enabled NO 2>&1 | tee "$tmp"; if grep -q "Executed 0 tests" "$tmp" || grep -q "No tests were executed" "$tmp"; then echo "gate:ios-deeplink-smoke failed: zero tests executed" >&2; rm -f "$tmp"; exit 4; fi; rm -f "$tmp"'
scripts.run:android: rspeedy build && node scripts/copy-bundles.mjs && ./android/gradlew -p android :app:installDebug && adb shell am start -n com.opencode.lynx/.SplashActivity
scripts.codex:refresh-bindings: codex app-server generate-ts --out scripts/codex-bindings/ts && codex app-server generate-json-schema --out scripts/codex-bindings/schema
